title: "Body Performance Analysis"
output: html_notebook

## Import

```{r}
body <- read.csv("bodyPerformance.csv")
names(body) <- c("age","gender","height","weight","fat","diastolic","systolic",
                 "grip","bend","situps","jump","class")
head(body)
dim(body)
str(body)
sum(is.na(body))
```

```{r}
body$gender <- as.factor(body$gender)
body$class <- as.factor(body$class)
```

```{r}
sum(body$systolic == 0)    # blood pressure = 0
sum(body$grip == 0)        # grip force = 0
sum(body$jump == 0)        # broad jump = 0
max(body$bend)             # 213 cm of flexibility: impossible
```

```{r}
body_clean <- body[body$systolic > 0 & body$diastolic > 0 &
                     body$grip > 0 & body$jump > 0 & body$bend < 100 & body$bend > 0, ]
dim(body_clean)

attach(body_clean)
```

## Categorical variables

```{r}
table(gender)
prop.table(table(gender))
```

```{r}
barplot(table(gender), col=c('plum2','slateblue'), main='Gender')
```

```{r}
table(class)
pie(table(class), main='Class')
table(gender, class)
```
